# Mailroom Reloaded: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/mailroom-reloaded` `0e1dbd0` on 30 October 2026.

## Counts

1,288 line-start `def test_` functions in 89 test files. The 11 October verification run (pytest 1,597 passed, 3 skipped; TUI Node 290) was not repeated. A later demo log recorded 1,842 passed and 378 TUI Node tests. That demo is not treated as a fresh main verification.

## Unreleased, from the source changelog

P6-B1–B5 operator commands, the operator SMS pager, llm-dojo-scoring re-vendored at v0.22.0, `/ui` and `/tui` contrast and focus work, and a `GET /ready` provider probe. The release version is still 0.4.2.

## Screenshots

The figures are from `545d8b7` with the mock provider. They were not re-shot against the current `/tui`.
